A little about me

I'm Martin Goffa, a developer with more than 4 years of professional experience. I don't see myself as just a programmer – I'm an engineer who takes ownership of the entire application lifecycle. My domain is .NET on the backend and Blazor on the frontend, and I hold the Microsoft Azure AI Cloud Developer Associate and Azure Network Engineer Associate certifications.

With today's AI, no technology is out of reach for me. I focus on AI-assisted development and integrating AI into applications, from MCP servers to AI assistants, while delivering high-quality, clean and maintainable code. Whether it's databases, networking or deployment, I have a broad reach across the whole IT spectrum.
